Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/dac\_user\_jcpds/Users data/sno2\_cubic\_27GPa.jcpds. The cubic PdF2/pyrite-type model uses Sn 4a and O 8c with u=0.346, as reported for high-pressure cubic SnO2 by Smith et al., J. Synchrotron Rad. 26, 858-867 (2019), doi:10.1107/S1600577519005579. The legacy 26.6 GPa peaks are retained.

Full comparison report: `docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json` (this record's identifier).

The 300 K reference isotherm for cubic Pa-3 SnO2. V0=130.6(3) A^3 means 130.6+/-0.3 A^3; the migrated +/-3.0 value was a decimal-place error. K0=252(28) GPa and K0'=3.5(2.2). V0 is a fitted extrapolation because the cubic phase transforms on decompression. Table 2 spans 16.09-28.85 GPa and 300-1400 K, but this record intentionally implements only the 300 K curve. No fitted-parameter covariance is published.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

## Observation datasets

### sno2\_ono\_2000\_table2\_pvt

- **Description:** All 40 cubic SnO2 P-V-T observations printed in Table 2.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_temperature
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Ono; Ito; Katsura; Yoneda; Walter; Urakawa; Utsumi; Funakoshi
    - **Year:** 2000
    - **Source:** Phys. Chem. Miner.
    - **Volume:** 27
    - **Locator:** 618-622
    - **DOI:** 10.1007/S002690000108
- **Source location:** Table 2, journal page 621
- **Associated EOS records:** sno2\_cubic\_27gpa\_ono\_2000\_bm3\_1
- **Notes:** The table contains 34 observations from experiment S145 and six from S192. Parenthetical last-digit pressure and volume uncertainties are retained as generic bounds because the paper does not label their statistical meaning. Pressure was obtained from Au using the Jamieson et al. (1982) EOS (K0=177 GPa, K0'=4.8), with a stated pressure uncertainty within +/-0.2 GPa. The paper says initial-heating data were excluded from Fig. 4 because of deviatoric stress but does not identify those rows individually, so the complete printed table is preserved.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/sno2-ono-2000-table2-pvt.csv)
